Brief Hospital Course:
___ yo male with CAD s/p multiple PCI, mitochondrial muscular

palpitations

# CORONARIES: CAD with multiple PCI in the past. Current 
presentation unlike previous episodes of chest pain. There were 
no significant ECG changes compared to prior.  Cardiac enzymes

abnormality (pt has hypokinesis of basal anterior septum 
consistent with prior infarct). Patient was continued on 
aspirin, plavix, statin and betablocker.     
.  
# RHYTHM: Pt c/o episodes palpitations and ""skipped beats""

blood pressure multiple times the day prior to hospitalization

140s. He describes similar sensation during a previous 
hospitalization this year in ___ for PNA in which he states 
he was diagnosed with afib. Diagnosis of a-fib is questionable 
given pt states he had heart rates over 200 at the time of 
diagnosis. Holter monitor performed in ___ revealed small 
amount of atrial ectopy. During this admission, pt was monitored 
on telemetry overnight with no events. Given questionable 
diagnosis and a CHADS score of 1, pt was not started on 
anticoagulation and continued on aspirin therapy. Pt denied any 
cardiac symptoms overnight and was discharged with ___ of 
Hearts monitor.  Pt was instructed to continue home medications 
and follow up with his cardiologist within the month.
